inputs_used: weddedwonderland.com live pages and official sources via Apify web-fetch
method_note: FAST MODE stage 1. Reused facts keep original checked dates. New facts verbatim from our live weddedwonderland.com pages and official pages only. No named operators without a /vendor profile. No invented prices, durations or perks; figures in original currency.

facts.claim: Medical assistance is usually the highest unexpected cost for Australians overseas. Most countries won't give you free or subsidised care. You, or your insurer, must usually pay full price.
facts.quote: Medical assistance is usually the highest unexpected cost for Australians overseas. Most countries won't give you free or subsidised care. You, or your insurer, must usually pay full price.

facts.claim: Smartraveller overall advice level for Maldives: 'Exercise a high degree of caution'. 'Exercise a high degree of caution in Maldives due to the risk of civil unrest and the threat of terrorism.'
facts.quote: Overall: Exercise a high degree of caution ... Exercise a high degree of caution in Maldives due to the risk of civil unrest and the threat of terrorism.
facts.use_note: Advice level can change before February; writer should say 'at the time of writing' and link the page.

facts.claim: Smartraveller: the Maldives monsoon season is usually mid-May to November, so February falls outside it.
facts.quote: The monsoon season is usually from mid-May to November. Strong winds, rough seas, torrential rain, and flash flooding can happen.
facts.use_note: Overview wording differs slightly: 'The monsoon season is from mid-May to November.' The 'February is outside' inference is ours; Smartraveller does not name February. Tsunami warning also on page.

facts.claim: May to October is the low season, which can lower resort rates. A package often covers the ceremony location, a basic floral arrangement and an officiant.
facts.use_note: Extractor wording. Page also: 'Most resorts are on private islands reached by seaplane or speedboat, and each guest travels on a separate fare.' Season claim is ours, not an official climate source.
facts.quote: May to October is the low season, which can lower resort rates. A package often covers the ceremony location, a basic floral arrangement and an officiant.

facts.claim: Smartraveller overall advice level for Indonesia: 'Exercise a high degree of caution in Indonesia overall due to security risks.'
facts.quote: Exercise a high degree of caution in Indonesia overall due to security risks.

facts.claim: Smartraveller: the wet season usually runs from October to April, when floods, landslides and mudslides occur regularly; heavy rains can cause significant flooding in urban areas including Bali. February falls in the wet season.
facts.quote: Floods, landslides and mudslides occur regularly during the wet season, which usually runs from October to April. ... Heavy rains can cause significant flooding in urban areas, including in Bali and the greater Jakarta region, disrupting transportation.
facts.use_note: Firecrawl LLM extraction; re-check verbatim. Also: 'Volcanic activity may escalate with little or no notice, causing flight delays, cancellations or airport closures'.

facts.claim: Our Bali hub says the dry season, April to October, is the most popular time to marry and has the most reliable weather for outdoor ceremonies.
facts.quote: the dry season, April to October, has the most reliable weather for outdoor ceremonies.
facts.use_note: Own page. Overlaps Smartraveller wet season at April and October (C-03). February is wet season on both.

facts.claim: Smartraveller overall advice level for Fiji: 'Exercise normal safety precautions in Fiji.' November to April is cyclone season, but cyclones may occur at other times; flooding is common, especially in downtown Nadi and on the Coral Coast, and floods can cut off road access, including to the airports.
facts.quote: November to April is cyclone season, but cyclones may occur at other times. ... Flooding is common, especially in downtown Nadi and on the Coral Coast. Floods can cut off road access, including to the airports.
facts.use_note: Level GREEN per page meta. Weather lines via Firecrawl LLM extraction; re-check verbatim.

facts.claim: Our Fiji hub month table rates February 'mixed': 'Wettest stretch for many areas; plan an indoor backup.' Its FAQ says May to October has the most settled weather and November to April is warmer and wetter and falls in the cyclone season.
facts.quote: Feb mixed. Wettest stretch for many areas; plan an indoor backup. ... May to October, Fiji's dry season, has the most settled weather. November to April is warmer and wetter and falls in the cyclone season.
facts.use_note: Own page as worded; consistent with Smartraveller. Hub also rates January 'peak of cyclone season risk'.

facts.claim: Smartraveller overall advice level for the UAE: 'Exercise a high degree of caution'. 'We now advise exercise a high degree of caution due to the threat of terrorism and the unpredictable security situation in the region.'
facts.quote: We now advise exercise a high degree of caution due to the threat of terrorism and the unpredictable security situation in the region.
facts.use_note: Raised in October 2026 citing regional security. Writer must state the level as at writing and link. Maldives page also notes many airlines have cancelled or reduced flights due to the conflict in the Middle East, relevant to Gulf hub routings.

facts.claim: Smartraveller UAE weather: intense storms can occur between December and May and may lead to flash flooding; in winter months morning fog can reduce visibility and cause flight delays; June to September temperatures can exceed 50°C.
facts.quote: Intense storms can occur between December and May and may lead to flash flooding. In winter months, morning fog can significantly reduce visibility. This can cause flight delays and road hazards. From June to September, temperatures can exceed 50°C, and sand and dust storms are common.
facts.use_note: Extracted by Firecrawl LLM extraction, not a full-text read; wording matches Smartraveller house style but re-check verbatim before quoting. February sits inside the December to May storm window.

facts.claim: Our Dubai best-time page tells couples to check Ramadan and Eid timing, which fall in February and March in 2027, and notes they follow the Islamic lunar calendar and move earlier each year.
facts.quote: Check Ramadan and Eid timing, which fall in February and March in 2027. ... Ramadan and Eid al-Fitr follow the Islamic lunar calendar and move earlier each year.
facts.use_note: Own page as worded (confirmed live). Per page summary it also calls November to March peak season and December to February the coolest months; not quoted verbatim, re-check before using. No official 2027 Ramadan date yet (N-10).

facts.claim: Smartraveller overall advice level for New Zealand: 'Exercise normal safety precautions in New Zealand.' Weather conditions can change quickly; creeks and rivers can experience flash flooding after heavy rains.
facts.quote: Exercise normal safety precautions in New Zealand. ... Weather conditions can change quickly. Severe weather can occur. Creeks and rivers can experience flash flooding after heavy rains.
facts.use_note: Level GREEN per page meta. No seasonal or month-specific weather warning. Weather lines via Firecrawl extraction.

facts.claim: NIWA's 'The climate and weather of Otago' (Macara, 2015): daily maximum temperatures in summer can exceed 30°C, especially about inland areas of Otago; dry spells of more than two weeks occur relatively frequently in Central Otago; Central Otago is the driest area of New Zealand.
facts.quote: However daily maximum temperatures in summer can exceed 30°C, especially about inland areas of Otago. ... Dry spells of more than two weeks occur relatively frequently in Central Otago, but less so elsewhere.
facts.publisher: NIWA (now Earth Sciences New Zealand), NIWA Science and Technology Series 67
facts.use_note: Official national climate agency report. Extracted from 44-page PDF by Firecrawl LLM; quotes look verbatim but re-check against the PDF. Not February-specific (summer = Dec to Feb). 'Driest area' and '<400 mm' came from the summary only; do not quote numbers without re-check. Queenstown monthly normals not captured (N-06).

facts.claim: Smartraveller advice level for Switzerland: 'Exercise normal safety precautions in Switzerland.' Avalanches, flash floods, rock falls, mudslides and sudden weather changes occur in alpine areas; people have died due to avalanches; mountain rescues can be extremely costly.
facts.quote: Exercise normal safety precautions in Switzerland. ... Avalanches, flash floods, rock falls, mudslides and sudden weather changes occur in alpine areas. Monitor local weather. ... People have died due to natural disasters including avalanches. Mountain rescues can be extremely costly. Check your travel insurance to ensure it covers you for planned activities.
facts.use_note: Page body shows level 1 'Exercise normal safety precautions' (confirmed from page markup). The page meta description says 'Exercise a high degree of caution. Travel advice level YELLOW' (C-05). Quote the body wording and re-check before publishing.

facts.claim: MeteoSwiss: the climate of Switzerland is strongly affected by the Alps and the Atlantic; Switzerland has four distinct seasons. MeteoSwiss also notes that the meteorological winter ends at the end of February.
facts.quote: The climate of Switzerland is strongly affected by the Alps and its proximity to the Atlantic Ocean. The south side of the Alps is mostly influenced by the Mediterranean Sea. Switzerland has four distinct seasons.
facts.publisher: MeteoSwiss (Federal Office of Meteorology and Climatology)
facts.use_note: Quote read from the page. The 'meteorological winter at the end of February' line comes from a search snippet of https://www.meteoswiss.admin.ch/weather/weather-and-climate-from-a-to-z/snow/snowfall-in-spring.html, not read in full; do not quote it until re-checked. No February Alpine normals captured (N-08).

facts.claim: Our Switzerland hub says winter (December to March) transforms the Alps into a snowy fairytale, ideal for romantic elopements or glamorous ski weddings; summer (June to September) brings lakeside weddings.
facts.quote: Switzerland is stunning year-round. Summer (June-September) brings lush lakeside weddings and outdoor celebrations, while winter (December-March) transforms the Alps into a snowy fairytale, ideal for romantic elopements or glamorous ski weddings.
facts.use_note: Own page as worded. Hub also links a St. Moritz winter real wedding (Gianna Grieco and Phillip Van Nostrand) and a winter venue round-up; check URLs before linking.

facts.claim: Smartraveller overall advice level for Thailand: 'Exercise a high degree of caution in Thailand overall due to security and safety risks.' Do not travel within 10 km of the Thailand-Cambodia land border in named provinces; reconsider your need to travel to Yala, Pattani and Narathiwat. Phuket is not in either named area.
facts.quote: Exercise a high degree of caution in Thailand overall due to security and safety risks. ... We continue to advise reconsider your need to travel to Yala, Pattani and Narathiwat provinces.
facts.use_note: 'Phuket not named' is our reading of the listed provinces.

facts.claim: Smartraveller: the wet season is usually May to December; in north and central Thailand usually May to November; in Koh Samui and the south-east of the peninsula usually October to December. February is outside all stated wet seasons.
facts.quote: Floods and extreme weather can disrupt essential services during the wet season, usually from May to December. ... The wet season in north and central Thailand is usually from May to November. In Koh Samui and the south-east of the peninsula, the wet season is usually from October to December.
facts.use_note: Firecrawl LLM extraction; re-check verbatim. No Phuket/Andaman-specific season stated; the 'February outside' inference is ours.

facts.claim: Smartraveller overall advice for Kenya: Exercise a high degree of caution. Higher levels apply in some areas.
facts.quote: Overall: Exercise a high degree of caution
facts.use_note: Overall line read from the page markdown. Updated 04 November 2026, still current 26 November 2026.

facts.claim: Do not travel to the Somalia border regions, including all of Mandera and Garissa counties and eastern Wajir county.
facts.quote: Do not travel to border regions with Somalia due to the high risk of terrorist attack and kidnapping, including all of Mandera and Garissa counties and the part of Wajir county extending from the town of Wajir eastwards to the border with Somalia.
facts.use_note: Firecrawl LLM extraction; check verbatim before publishing. Latest update also notes Ebola health screening on arrival, mandatory ETA and mandatory inbound travel health insurance via the ETA.

facts.claim: Kenya normally has two rainy seasons, March to June and October to November; flash flooding and mudslides are common.
facts.quote: Kenya normally has two rainy seasons: from March to June and October to November. ... Flash flooding and mudslides are common.
facts.use_note: Firecrawl LLM extraction of the Extreme weather section; check verbatim. No KMD season page read (see needs).

facts.claim: Rainy season March to May and November to December; monsoons in coastal and island areas July to October; cyclones in coastal areas are common.

facts.claim: The rainy season is from November to March and can bring heavy rainfall and thunderstorms; flash floods can occur across the country.

facts.use_note: LLM extraction, check verbatim. This is a national line: the Western Cape (Cape Town, Winelands) has winter rainfall, so do not apply 'November to March' to Cape Town. See C-01 and N-ZA-season (SAWS).

facts.claim: Our African honeymoon page: safari at its best May to October; Botswana dry season May to October with Delta flood waters peaking June to August; South African reserves best May to September and Cape Town November to March; Victoria Falls water highest March to June, lower water September to December allows Devil's Pool on the Zambian side; 5 to 7 nights safari then 3 to 4 nights Zanzibar.
facts.quote: Safari is at its best from May to October, and the rainy months reward couples who want quieter camps. ... The dry season runs from May to October, and flood waters peak in the Delta from June to August. ... Reserves are at their best from May to September, and Cape Town shines from November to March. ... Water levels are highest from March to June, and from September to December the lower water allows swimming at Devil's Pool on the Zambian side.
facts.use_note: Final URL (old /expert-advice/african-honeymoons-private-safari-and-island-escapes-by-season redirects here). LLM extraction; mapping of each sentence to a country inferred from order, check on page. Also: 'The best months are June to September and December to February' (destination not confirmed). Page mentions a daily conservation levy, no amount. Own page, not official season source.

facts.experience: Great Barrier Reef and Whitsundays sailing
facts.claim: 'The Whitsundays gather 74 islands in sheltered water off Queensland. Couples can sail between them on a private charter, swim over reef and spend nights at an island resort. May to October is the driest period, with comfortable water temperatures. Marine stinger season runs from around November to May, so we suggest planning in the cooler months, with 4 to 6 nights in total.'
facts.publisher: Wedded Wonderland, 12 Oceania Honeymoon Destinations (Jillian Arambulo)
facts.use_note: Our own wording. The stinger and dry-season lines are our page, not BoM or GBRMPA; pair with an official source if stated as fact. 4 to 6 nights is our suggestion, label as such.

facts.experience: Fiji island and Yasawas yacht charter
facts.claim: 'Fiji suits couples who want private-island seclusion with warm, easygoing service. The Mamanuca and Yasawa islands hold adults-only resorts and villas with their own pools, and a yacht charter through the Yasawas visits quiet bays and villages. May to October is the dry season. We suggest 7 to 10 nights, and Fiji pairs well with New Zealand or Australia.'
facts.publisher: Wedded Wonderland, 12 Oceania Honeymoon Destinations (Jillian Arambulo)
facts.use_note: Our wording. No operator named. Pair season with R-08 (Smartraveller cyclone season Nov to Apr).

facts.experience: Queenstown helicopter flights and Central Otago wine
facts.claim: 'Queenstown sits on Lake Wakatipu beneath the Southern Alps. Helicopter flights to remote peaks, private wine tours of Central Otago and lakeside dining give a balance of thrill and polish. December to February is summer, and June to August brings snow. We suggest 4 to 5 nights, and we help couples sequence it with Fiordland if they wish.'
facts.publisher: Wedded Wonderland, 12 Oceania Honeymoon Destinations (Jillian Arambulo)
facts.use_note: Our wording. Pair with R-13 and R-14 (Smartraveller NZ, NIWA Otago). No helicopter operator named.

facts.claim: 'Uluru offers a different Australia. Sunrise over the rock, a private dinner under the desert sky and guided walks around its base are the highlights, and visits are led with respect for the Anangu traditional owners. facts.claim: 'Tasmania suits couples who love food, wine and wilderness. Freycinet's coast, the Bay of Fires, farm-to-table dining and the Museum of Old and New Art give the island real range. December to March is the warmest period, and 5 to 7 nights works well.'
facts.publisher: Wedded Wonderland, 12 Oceania Honeymoon Destinations (Jillian Arambulo)

facts.claim: 'Margaret River in Western Australia combines wineries, tall-timber forest and surf beaches. Cellar-door tastings, private dining and coastal walks fill unhurried days. September to November and March to May are comfortable, and spring brings wildflowers. We suggest 4 to 6 nights.'

facts.experience: Great Barrier Reef and Whitsundays sailing
facts.claim: 'For most tourism operations, the environmental management charge (EMC) is calculated on a per person, per day (or part-day) rate.' 'Full day passenger (pax) $8.50 per day for: trips of three hours or more'. 'Part day passenger (pax) $4.25 per part-day visitor for: trips of less than three hours'. 'Important: From 1 April 2027: EMC for full day passengers will increase by $0.50, bringing the new charge to $9.00; EMC for part-day passengers visit will increase by $0.25, bringing the new charge to $4.50'. 'This charge is collected by the permit holder and remitted to the Reef Authority on a quarterly basis.'
facts.publisher: Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Authority (Reef Authority)
facts.use_note: Official rule: reef visitors on a commercial tour pay the EMC through their permitted operator. Figures in AUD as published. Optional line; it is a permit-holder charge, not a separate visitor permit.
